camera_policy: fixed within rally; continuous X/Z on both baseline-rear fence planes
event_policy: native simulation-frame ownership before nearest output-frame mapping; hypothetical post-return bounces excluded
selection_policy: truncate at first fence exit; bounded resampling of short/behind-camera/full-physics-rejected rallies; attempts in each record
split_policy: seeded rally-disjoint; every view and temporal window follows its parent rally
